items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: He and I and Tony Amico... And the three of us were very, very friendly.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah. And he was a natural funny guy anyway. Because like after the gig we always used to go to Stark’s Restaurant in Newark in town. He and I and Tony Amico who was the head waiter. It was the band leader, the head waiter and the comic. And the three of us were very, very friendly. And we’d go into town to Stark’s Restaurant and have morning breakfast like, and then come back and go to our rooms. Beautiful memories, beautiful. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
This music you were playing, when did you first get into what you would call a jazz band?
